Bug_Title: Classes that don't define "hashCode()" should not be used in hashes
Bug_Explanation: The Student class defines equals(Object) but does not override hashCode(). This violates the contract that equal objects must have the same hash code, causing issues when using Student instances in hash-based collections. In the showBug method, student2, which is equal to student1 by equals method, may not be found in the map due to differing hash codes.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug method and verifies that an equivalent student object (student2) does not retrieve the correct grade due to missing hashCode implementation, causing the test to fail as expected.
